title: What do you do if the ball won't stay in the relief area?
question: If you drop the ball twice and it still won’t stay in the relief area, what does the Rule require you to do?

choices.text: Place the ball on the spot where it first touched the ground after the second drop
Place it anywhere in the relief area

explanation: If a dropped ball twice fails to stay within the defined relief area, you must place it on the spot where it touched the ground after the second drop.
